text: This application proposes to amend the Official Plan and zoning by-law to permit a 7-storey (24.0 metres including mechanical space) mixed-use apartment building at 179-181 Finch Avenue East. The proposed building would have a total gross floor area of 3,806.6 square metres including 40 square metres of retail space, 40 residential dwelling units and 22 vehicular parking spaces. The proposal also includes 101 square metres of outdoor amenity space and 348 square metres of indoor amenity space. The proposed development is consistent with the Provincial Planning Statement (2024). It will provide housing options in an appropriate built form, intensifying an underutilized site along a major street in a way that is transit supportive and respectful of both the existing and planned context.
